title: Container base image is not pinned in dockerfile — review required
description: The FROM line names a tag such as latest, or omits the tag entirely. The image resolved at build time is then whatever the registry points at that day, so two builds of the same commit can contain different operating-system packages. Pinning a version and preferably a digest makes the base reproducible and reviewable.
remediation: Pin the base image to a specific version and digest, and update it through a reviewed dependency process.
limitation: Lexical: reads the FROM line only; digest pinning is checked by review.

tests.line: # audit: FROM node:latest AS build present
